description: This test file defines tests for the 'msteams' conversation store implementations, verifying behaviors such as ID normalization, CRUD operations, user reference handling, timezone preservation, and handling multiple interactions for the same user. It uses vitest for testing purposes.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates a conversation entry in the store with provided details, handling timezone preservation and ID normalization.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a conversation entry from the store based on its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a conversation entry from the store by its ID, returning true if successful.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all conversation entries currently stored.

methods.name: findPreferredDmByUserId
methods.description: Finds the most recent direct message conversation for a user by their user ID, ignoring whitespace and case.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Finds conversations associated with a user by user ID, potentially including multiple related conversations.
